approval_ref: v0.4.4 closure handoff V04-05-T01 under the capability-boundary report campaign

source_tasks.source_task: Implement the shared F/G/X capability model and Builder Capability Build Contract, then rebuild option intake against it.
source_tasks.authority: v0.4.4 closure handoff and capability-boundary report campaign.

source_tasks.source_task: Introduce a versioned reusable module and verified-template registry.
Separate Customer Runtime, Engineer Studio, and Governance Console and expose platform task/cost/evidence views.
Productize Evaluation Harness profiles, scoped verification states, generated tests, and environment selection.
Implement the daily web-collection pressure scenario on a durable job substrate.
Implement the customer-system embedding pressure scenario and Connector/Embedding SDK boundary.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: A typed F/G/X Capability Build Contract models dependencies, exclusions, E0-E5 envelope, orthogonal risk, environment availability, carrier decisions, platform/evaluation ownership, evidence plan, and claim scope; deterministic closure and three materially different reference scenarios are inspectable.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Pydantic schema and closure tests for dependency order, missing/excluded capabilities, envelope calculation, unavailable external contracts, carrier gaps, and Codex/daily-collection/embedding reference contracts.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: AI option intake emits typed decision axes and option effects, and a ready response contains a valid model-produced Capability Build Contract plus a customer-readable workflow-building plan rendered from that same contract without replacing model reasoning with a fixed template.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Prompt/schema assertions, deterministic needs_input and ready provider replays, answer snapshot checks, compatibility normalization, and plan/contract consistency assertions.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: The exact contract persists through application draft, content hash, publication version, and Builder state; read/validate APIs expose closure, and contract-aware routing reports envelope and risk separately while legacy complexity routing remains only a no-contract fallback.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Round-trip storage/version tests, API validation tests, content-hash mutation test, contract-derived planning/routing tests, and legacy compatibility tests.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: Builder Team can inspect the authoritative contract, maps BuildPlan modules to capability IDs, chooses and binds a declared carrier before completion, exposes platform/evaluation/external ownership, and treats unavailable X contracts as scoped evidence gaps rather than workflow graph defects.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Builder tool schema/operation tests, carrier-binding validation, build output/state assertions, strict missing-binding result, and unavailable-contract bounded-claim case.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: The customer flow displays F/G/X option effects and final contract, sends it into application creation, and preserves capability IDs, evidence target, and claim scope through generated acceptance and repair context; all three reference requirements remain distinct and the repository regression gate stays green.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Frontend contract tests, acceptance-repair context test, three-scenario integration replay, TypeScript lint/build, current release gate, and full repository diagnostic.
